newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAB BUYS ROMANIAN ASSETS FROM BUB .
newsitem.headline: SAB BUYS ROMANIAN ASSETS FROM BUB .

text.p: South African Breweries Ltd (SAB) said on Wednesday it had reached agreement to acquire the Romanian brewing interests of Germany's Brau und Brunnen AG (BUB) for an undisclosed amount.

SAB said the agreement, which will take effect from November 1, follows BUB's decision to relinquish all its central and eastern European investments in a bid to focus on its German brewing activities.

The acquisition will allow SAB to be come a leading force in the Romanian brewing industry, it in a statement. SAB, which is the world's fourth largest brewer, already owns a 70 percent stake in the Vulturul brewery.

BUB's Romanian operations, held by Brau und Brunnen International GmbH, consist of a 73.44 percent shareholding in the Ursus S.A. brewery and an 81.26 percent stake in the Pitber S.A. brewery near Bucharest, SAB said.
Ursus has an annual capacity of about 700,000 hectolitres per year, while Pitber is currently being expanded to 750,000.

SAB earlier this month announced an international share offering of around $360 million to fund its offshore expansion. It said at the time the offering could be raised to $410 million if there was sufficient demand.
